'''Spennie''' was a [[Gender|female]] from [[Coruscant]] who served as a member of the [[Resistance]]'s [[Cobalt Squadron]]. She served as the tail [[gunner]] of the [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|MG-100 StarFortress SF-17]] ''[[Cobalt Hammer]]'' during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of [[D'Qar]] where she was [[Death|killed]] by [[First Order]] forces.

==Biography==
Spennie was a native of [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Bomber Command" /> and served as a member of the [[Resistance]]'s [[Cobalt Squadron]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Spennie served as the tail [[gunner]] of the [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|Resistance bomber]] ''[[Cobalt Hammer]]'' during the [[Atterra campaign]]<ref name="Cobalt Squadron" /> and later the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of [[D'Qar]].<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Right before the battle she reported that her gun turret's systems were green. She was [[Death|killed]] when her bomber was destroyed during its successful attack run against the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Personality and traits==
Spennie was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Cobalt Squadron" /> who enjoyed listening to old recordings of space [[yacht]] races during her downtime. She occasionally let [[Rose Tico]] take over the rear turret to make visual observations.<ref name="IncrediBuilds">''[[Star Wars: Resistance Bomber Book and 3D Wood Model]]''</ref>
